methodology.expected_wins: For each team, the midpoint of the executable Yes bid/ask at every P(W >= k), k=1..17, is weighted by inverse spread, projected to a non-increasing curve, and summed. This is a modeled midpoint estimate, not a directly observed expected-win quote.
methodology.bounds: Bid and ask tail curves are separately projected to non-increasing order and summed. Aggregate bounds are sums of marginal team bounds, not a joint portfolio guarantee.
methodology.scanner: At sportsbook-observed thresholds, the same-book paired and de-vigged sportsbook probability is compared with the executable Kalshi Yes or No ask. Reported edge is pre-fee and does not include slippage.
